name: Mason Dixon Saloon
tagline: Good Food. Cold Drinks. Great Times.
about: If you're a meat connoisseur, you know the difference an in-house smoker can make. You won't be disappointed when you visit Mason Dixon Saloon for delicious smoked meats. We smoke our pork baby back ribs and slow cook the meat for our Reubens. We even have a special dry rub for wings, burgers, pork baby back ribs, pork loins and beef loins.
